description:

For free materials, you can visit the CLO official account "CLO3D" and reply "home" in the backend to obtain them.

summary: ```markdown # CLO 2024 Course: A Cozy Cottage in Winter - Learn Home Goods Production with CLO! ## Introduction The theme of our live broadcast today is homemade products. We will be creating various items for a cozy cottage setting, including bedding and towels. ## Overview of Products We will create: - Four sets for the bed, including: - Back cover - Pillows - Folding towel - Hanging towel - Hair roll blanket - Window curtains ## Getting Started Let’s start making the four sets. First, we find the folder in the material and then import the project file. The material will also be shared later. After importing, there is already a board in it. If you don't have a board, you can use a lifting tool according to your size. You can just make one. ### Creating the Back Cover Now I have imported the board. Let's start with the first one, the back cover. For other unused boards, we can select the middle and right keys to reverse activate them. This will prevent them from participating in the simulation. Next, we select the middle board and use the quick arrangement button to arrange it. Then we move it to the area near the bed and adjust the positioning ball. The positioning ball I use can see that it is the world coordinate. The positioning ball can be empty at the 3D window. Right-click to change its coordinate. Then I use the hook and loop tool to hook the baseline on the back cover. Use the back key to hook the internal line. After that, we use the direct arrangement tool to fold it down, as we want to wrap the bed battery in. ### Activating the Bed Battery Now, we adjust the position. The bed battery is currently in the state of activation. We want to reverse activate it; otherwise, it will conflict with the bed, causing the simulation to be unstable. First, reverse activate this bed. The bed battery is not reverse activated yet. Then we can switch to GPU simulation, available in the 2024.2 version. You can download the new version and try it. ### Simulating the Back Cover Because the bed cover is very large, using normal simulation may be laggy. So we will use GPU simulation. First, simulate the back cover on the bed battery. Then, use this tool to divide the four sides and select these four sides with the adjustment board tool. We add a spring to better wrap the bed battery. After simulating, you can see the effect of its wrapping. Next, we select the inner line inside; there is no need to delete it. We then select the spring board and make it vertical, adjusting it slightly lower, for example, to 8. ### Finalizing the Back Cover After opening the simulation, we can see that the simulated effect is good. Now, we freeze the bed battery because we have completed this step. ### Creating the Quilt Next, we will make the quilt. First, we activate it, quickly arrange it near the bed battery, and adjust its position. We place it in the middle of the bed battery. From the angle of 5, we can see it better. We adjust it a little forward and let it fall a bit below the front. Now we can simulate it. Since the bed battery was activated recently, a bed film appears, which we delete. Then, we activate the bed battery first, right-click to activate, and simulate again. If the simulation effect is not good, we can test the effect and adjust as needed. ### Adjusting the Quilt for Inflation Now, we clone a board to create an inflation effect. We can modify its pressure; no need to change the pressure here since there is no line in the middle of this quilt. If the pressure is very high, it will be very strong and float. We adjust to 3 here, making it smaller. For the bottom of this board, we can slightly increase the pressure, adjusting it to negative 5. ### Fabric Properties Because the bottom of the board is big, high pressure helps it float below rather than up. After simulating, we can see this effect. The top is more powerful, so we open the simulation again. Now we can test the effect; the fabric is white and soft. We can change it to a cotton fabric, which is relatively hard, and simulate again. ### Fine-Tuning the Quilt We can modify details, for example, reducing the pressure on the top and increasing it on the bottom board to keep it down. We can also stretch it and hold down the W key, pressing the key to add a fixed point to adjust the shape of this quilt. After simulating, we freeze the quilt. ### Adding Pillows Next, we create a small plate that folds up. We select this plate and quickly arrange it on top of this quilt. After activating it, we adjust the position of this plate to create a folding effect for the quilt. We separate two plates for simulation. After sewing the line, we open the simulation and adjust the position again. ### Final Adjustments to the Pillows The next step is to simulate. After some adjustments, we can put this panel on a layer. We adjust its pressure similarly to how we adjusted the quilt. ### Creating the Side of the Pillow Now, we move on to the edge of the pillow. First, we clear the joint of the plate, select the side of the board to the right, and expand on the outside of the board to add a flower edge effect. After cutting, we adjust the plate and activate it in the 3D window. We can delete the powder lines we don't need. ### Finalizing the Pillows We use free powder to make a seam of these two pillow plates and harden the edge of the flower. We open the simulation and adjust as necessary. Once the pillow is done, we freeze it and select another pillow, adjusting its position to match. ### Displaying the Completed Products Now we can duplicate the other pillows, adjusting their positions to create a cohesive look on the bed. We will then display our completed model, ensuring all elements are in place and visually appealing. ## Conclusion In this session, we have successfully created various homemade products, including a cozy bed set and towels, using CLO 2024. This course has provided insights into the production of home goods with a focus on simulation and modeling techniques. ```
